SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
CONFIDENTIAL
Special Branch S.B.D. Station,
REPORT
File No. POLICE REGISTRY
Date June 11, 1938.

Subject W.D. PAWLEY, American.

Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by C. Crawford A.J

In regard to the reference made on the attached report
to W.D. PAWLEY, I have to state that this individual, an
American citizen, is a well-to-do business man of good
standing and considerable repute in the local American
community. He is the President of the American registered
concerns:
(1) Curtiss-Wright Export Corporation and
(2) The Intercontinent Corporation,
the offices of which, until May 31, 1938, were located at
The China Development Building (8th. Floor): 181 Kiangse
Road.

The principal business conducted by these firms, which
have been operating in Shanghai for over five years, was
the import for the Chinese Government of Aeroplanes and
accessories, munitions and war supplies, various scientific
instruments, Sperry gyroscopes, etc. etc. Since the
commencement of Sino-Japanese hostilities, however, the
above companies have been conducting their business direct
with the Chinese Government authorities and not through
any third parties with the result that it has been found
not necessary to continue with the local offices.

Mr. Pawley left Shanghai in the Spring of 1937 and
apart from one trip to Shanghai, Hongkong and Hankow during
the early part of the current year, has been a resident
of the United States. Nevertheless he is very well known
in local business circles and no information is forthcoming that
in any way would reflect upon his character.

D.S.
D.C. (Special Branch).
F. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)

（左侧批注及印章）：
D. (Crawford)
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 13 JUNE 1938）
FILE
J.R.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
机密
特别分部 S.B.D. 警署，
报告
档案编号 警务登记处
日期 1938年6月11日。

事由 W.D. PAWLEY，美国人。

制作人 D.S. Pitts。转呈人 C. Crawford A.J

关于附呈报告中提及的 W.D. PAWLEY，本人谨陈述如下：此人为美国公民，是当地美侨社区中一位富裕、地位良好且享有相当声誉的商人。他是两家在美国注册公司的总裁：
(1) 柯蒂斯-莱特出口公司 (Curtiss-Wright Export Corporation) 以及
(2) 洲际公司 (The Intercontinent Corporation)，
这两家公司的办事处直至1938年5月31日均位于江西路181号中国建设大厦（8楼）。

这些公司在上海经营已超过五年，其主要业务是为中国政府进口飞机及配件、军火和军用物资、各类科学仪器、斯佩里陀螺仪等。然而，自中日敌对行动开始以来，上述公司一直直接与中国政府当局开展业务，不再通过任何第三方，因此发现已无必要保留本地办事处。

Pawley 先生于1937年春季离开上海，除今年年初曾前往上海、香港和汉口一次外，一直居住在美国。尽管如此，他在本地商界仍广为人知，目前也未收到任何有损其品格的信息。

D.S.
副总监（特别分部）。
助理总监致副总监（特别分部）

（左侧批注及印章）：
D. (Crawford)
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特别分部 1938年6月13日）

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
D. C. Crime
e.g. a box of live ammunition found in an unoccupied office.
At 9.55a.m. on 6/6/38 a telephone message was received from the China Development Finance Corporation, 181 Nanking Road to the effect that a box of ammunition had been found and requesting that it be taken over.
C.D.C. 100 and the undersigned attended and interviewed the sub-manager Mr. Lee Siung (李思敬) who produced a cardboard containing live ammunition as follows:-
58 rounds of .30 Springfield ammunition..
16 clips of .30 ammunition.
10 rounds of .45 pistol ammunition.
2 shot gun cartridges.
Mr. Lee stated that a firm known as the Intercontinent Corporation, President Mr. W.E. Pawley, American, had until 31/5/38 occupied a suite of offices on the 8th floor of the China Development Building, but on the latter date had removed to Hongkong.
This morning, 6/6/38, at 8a.m., the offices were being cleaned out in preparation for a new tenant when Mr. Lee who was examining the cupboards etc. found the box of ammunition and decided that it was best to hand it to the Police.
Ammunition accordingly/will be passed to Arms Identification Section for disposal.
Det. i/c.

例如：在一间空置办公室内发现一箱实弹。
1938年6月6日上午9时55分，接到南京路181号中国建设银公司的电话留言，称发现一箱弹药，请求警方接管。
巡长100号及本人到场，会见副经理李思敬 (Lee Siung) 先生，他出示了一个装有实弹的纸箱，内容如下：-
.30口径斯普林菲尔德子弹58发。
.30口径子弹夹16个。
.45口径手枪子弹10发。
猎枪子弹2发。
李先生称，一家名为洲际公司 (Intercontinent Corporation) 的企业，总裁为美国人 W.E. Pawley 先生，直至1938年5月31日一直占用中国建设大厦8楼的一套办公室，但于该日迁往香港。
今日早晨，1938年6月6日8时，办公室正在清理以备新租户入驻，李先生在检查橱柜等物时发现了这箱弹药，并决定最好将其移交警方。
该批弹药将 accordingly/移交枪械鉴定科处置。
